summary: the dhcp suite's step that requires arping's status 0, with an arping that fails at once on an interface the guest lacks

argv: rm -f "$1/dhcp.trace"; status=0; RACH2_TRACE="$1/dhcp.trace" make dhcp-card "ARCH=$ARCH" || status=$?; cat "$1/dhcp.trace" "$ARCH_BUILD/images/dhcp.log" 2>/dev/null; exit "$status"

faults.name: arping
faults.summary: arping sent to eth9, which the guest has not, so it exits 2 at once and the status step fails
